title: nan
authors: Wang Z.; Song C.; Hao M.; Liang X.
key_contribution: Presents a relative navigation method combining datalink ranging, airspeed, altitude, and partial swarm guidance information to enhance observability for UAV swarms in GNSS-denied environments.
problem_solved: Addressing state estimation drift in GNSS-denied navigation.
methodology_summary: Fuses sensor data using Multi_Agent_Collaborative_SLAM to ensure precise positioning.
